environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 2 with default action, (3) a custom rule at priority 3 with a RegexPatternSet matching body/query-string inspection using SizeConstraint on URI query string limited to 128 bytes. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress beyond the VPC (no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints for external services), and the task runs with a read-only root filesystem with /var/data mounted as an EFS volume with encryption at rest.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL

waf_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
waf_rules.note: Includes SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS, SQLi_BODY, SQLi_COOKIE with sensitivity level HIGH

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT gateway, no internet egress
config.database: SQLite on EFS with encryption at rest
